title: Butterflies over Eyeball Field
description: A person sees many butterflies flying in the sky above a green grassy hill. The ground is covered with large white eyeballs that have orange and blue irises scattered in the grass under a cloudy sky.
prompt: A surreal scene of many monarch butterflies flying in the air over a lush green grassy hill under a sky with large white clouds. The field is covered with scattered large white eyeballs that have orange irises and some with blue irises resting in the grass.
